page.overview:
Who is Badger-brock?

Badger-brock was one of the Badger-folk mentioned in Hobbit verse and folklore.

He lived with his wife and many sons in a secret house near the Withywindle. One day, he kidnapped Tom Bombadil, dragging him to his burrow. However, Tom scared all the Badger-folk there with his singing power, and they released him.
